vaultScreen.benefit1: • Keep hits inside Pull Hub — build a real collection, not one-off shipments.
vaultScreen.benefit2: • Vault Exchange: friends see your whole Vault — request anything; only your listings get Buy now (card checkout).
vaultScreen.benefit3: • Request shipment on your schedule — fewer rushed labels, calmer fulfillment.

vaultScreen.benefit5: • Nothing expires or converts automatically. Shipping and Trade in require your confirmation.

wonPrizesModal.title: Vault or Trade in
wonPrizesModal.lead: Every pull is stored in Vault by default. Uncheck a row only when you want to Trade in for Points now. Shipping starts from Vault when you are ready.
wonPrizesModal.summaryAllVault: Everything here will stay in your Vault until you choose to ship, list, trade, or Trade in.
wonPrizesModal.summaryAllConvert: The full batch will be Traded in after you confirm. Points are added only after this explicit action.
wonPrizesModal.summaryMixed: Selected rows stay in Vault. Unselected rows will be Traded in for Points after you confirm.
wonPrizesModal.checkboxHint: Default: Vault. Uncheck a row only when you want to Trade in for Points.
wonPrizesModal.footerVaultLine: No expiry · no automatic Trade in
wonPrizesModal.confirmBody: Points are added for every row you explicitly Trade in. Selected Vault rows remain stored.
wonPrizesModal.confirmVaultNote: The other {{count}} pulls remain secured in Vault with no expiration.

vaultAsset.timerFine: This item remains in Vault until you explicitly request shipping, listing, trade, or Trade in.
vaultAsset.requestShipBody: We’ll prepare this Vault item for fulfillment. You can track status from pull history once logistics are live.
vaultAsset.convertBody: Trade in {{coins}} Points now. The physical claim for this Vault slot closes.
vaultAsset.listedLine: Vault Exchange · {{price}} · Buy now for friends
vaultAsset.unlistBody: This removes the Vault Exchange listing. The card stays in your Vault.
vaultAsset.tradeSoonBody: Peer trades will open from Vault — send offers, counter, and lock in when both sides agree (separate from fixed-price shop).
vaultAsset.shipStatusLine: Shipment is queued for this item. We’ll notify you when the label is ready.
vaultAsset.readOnly: This item isn’t editable from here.

vaultList.title: Vault Exchange listing
vaultList.body: Set a fixed USD price. Friends can buy instantly with card checkout (no Points). You keep the hit vaulted until it sells or you delist.

friendVaultShop.buyBody: {{price}} for {{card}} — moves to your Vault after payment.
friendVaultShop.boughtBody: Check the Vault tab — your new hit is secured there.
friendVaultShop.ownBody: Change price or delist from the Vault tab.

vaultExchange.checkoutBody: Peer sales use real payments (e.g. Stripe) — not wallet Points. This build simulates a successful charge so you can test the flow.
vaultExchange.friendSectionHint: Full collection is visible. Request, offer, or ask on anything. Only Vault Exchange listings show Buy now with a cash price.
vaultExchange.emptyVault: No secured hits in the Vault yet. When they vault pulls, everything shows up here for discovery.
vaultExchange.buyNowFine: Charged in USD. Platform fee may apply at real checkout.
vaultExchange.requestableLead: Not listed for instant sale. You can still show interest — the seller may add a Vault Exchange price later.
vaultExchange.selfSheetHint: Others browse this same grid. To enable Buy now, add a Vault Exchange listing from your Vault tab.
vaultExchange.purchaseOkBody: The hit is in your Vault. Production will route card funds through Pull Hub before payout to the seller.
vaultExchange.purchaseFailBody: That listing may have just sold or been delisted. Refresh and try again.

stub.requestBody: Production: we’d route a structured request to {{handle}} so they can reply or list on Vault Exchange.
stub.offerBody: Production: send a trade or cash offer thread — separate from fixed-price Buy now.
stub.askBody: Production: a light nudge to {{handle}} — still not a purchase until they list or accept.

progression.streakFine: Visit on consecutive days to build your streak. Miss a day and it resets — by design, not a trap.
progression.questsResetHint: Weekly goals refresh each Monday. Rewards are collector XP only — not pack odds.

daily_collector_log.title: Collector’s log
daily_collector_log.desc: Check in with Pull Hub today. Keeps your streak and completes this daily goal.

weekly_open_packs.title: Open five packs
weekly_open_packs.desc: Any packs count — pace yourself. Progress tracks when a pull is secured to your session.

weekly_secure_vault.title: Secure two hits
weekly_secure_vault.desc: Send two pulls to your Vault from the post-open sheet.

weekly_convert.title: Convert one Vault hit
weekly_convert.desc: Cash a vaulted item to Points once this week.

weekly_add_friend.title: Grow your circle
weekly_add_friend.desc: Add one friend by username — trades and Vault Exchange are better together.

serviceAvailability.title: Not available in this release
serviceAvailability.body: This connection stays disabled until its provider, data handling, and recovery flow are verified for production.
